study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study (clinical trial)
outcome: Admission to an intensive care unit
cohort: The study participants were women with HIV infection and their infants, enrolled in the BAN Study between 2004-2010.
finding: Odds of serious maternal and neonatal morbidity were higher after cesarean than vaginal delivery, despite lower maternal viral loads.
mod_finding: The study found that serious maternal and neonatal morbidity was significantly higher following cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
